title: The Quiet Bell
author: Elodie Quintana
blurb: Xanthe Pemberton, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
